why.title: Why join us ?
descriptions: Joining Yifang Group offers great opportunities for growth and development. The company is known for its innovative projects and collaborative culture, making it an exciting place to work.

With a strong reputation and global presence, Yifang Group provides competitive benefits and the chance to work with diverse teams, making it an ideal choice for professionals looking to advance their careers.

start.title: Are you ready to turn your Mandarin skills into real career opportunities?
descriptions: Join the Yifang Mandarin Talent Program to develop your language, professional, and business skills while preparing for a career in a Mandarin-speaking work environment.

mandarin.title: Explore exciting career opportunities at Yifang Group
descriptions: across production, quality control, warehousing, logistics, maintenance, administration, IT, customer service, hospitality, and security, with opportunities for SMA/SMK graduates who are ready to learn, work, and grow with us.

mechanical.title: Join Yifang Group as a Motorcycle Technician
descriptions: build your career by performing motorcycle maintenance and repairs, ensuring every vehicle operates safely and efficiently through your technical expertise and hands-on experience.
